family_name: Bradford Anticon Roofing Blanket - Medium Duty Foil

spec.description:
Bradford Anticon Roofing Blanket - Medium Duty Foil is the
benchmark residential and light-commercial metal roof insulation blanket,
factory-laminated with a Medium Duty reflective foil facing. Engineered for
support spacings up to 900mm centres without safety mesh, it combines a
bio-soluble glasswool blanket with a robust vapour-barrier foil to minimise
condensation risk, attenuate rain drumming noise, and reflect radiant summer
heat. With a 150mm foil overlap edge, it delivers reliable thermal efficiency
and bushfire protection up to BAL-FZ.
features:
Faced with Medium Duty
reflective foil laminate for standard residential and light commercial builds

Engineered for batten and purlin spans up to 900mm centres without requiring
wire mesh

Factory-bonded 150mm foil overlap edge ensures a continuous,
airtight vapour barrier

Non-combustible glasswool core compliant with
AS 1530.1

Bushfire ember attack protection certified from BAL 12.5 to BAL FZ
under AS 3959

Damps heavy rain noise by up to 7 dB for a significantly
quieter living environment

Reflects up to 97% of radiant heat to lower
household heating and cooling loads

Made with up to 65% recycled glass using
FBS-1 bio-soluble formulation

Sensitive Choice approved for allergy and
asthma sufferers
Available in thicknesses from 60mm to 130mm (R1.3 to R3.0)

install:
Confirm
roof batten spacing is 900mm centres or less

Roll out Anticon Medium Duty
over rafters or battens with the foil facing downwards into the roof space

Allow a nominal 25-40mm sag between battens to prevent compression against the
roof sheet
Overlap adjacent rolls by 150mm using the pre-extended foil edge

Tape all foil joins with Bradford 493 Reinforced Aluminium Foil Tape using a
squeegee to achieve an airtight vapour barrier

Fasten metal roofing sheets
directly over the blanket using recommended screws with neoprene washers
Ensure installation is covered before rain occurs
selection_checklist:
Confirm framing spacing is ≤ 900mm centres (standard for most domestic metal
roofs)
Verify total system R-value calculation meets NCC energy compliance

Select thickness (60mm R1.3, 80mm R1.8, 100mm R2.3, 110mm R2.5, or 130mm
R3.0)
Ensure Bradford 493 tape is ordered for sealing the 150mm overlap
Confirm bushfire BAL requirements (BAL 12.5 to BAL FZ)
limitations:
Do not span greater than 900mm centres without wire mesh
(specify Heavy Duty for spans up to 1200mm)

Must be kept dry prior to and
during installation
Foil must always face down toward the building interior

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford
Anticon Roofing Blanket - Medium Duty Foil is the standard residential and
light-commercial metal roof insulation blanket, laminated with a Medium Duty
reflective foil facing and a 150mm overlap flap. Engineered for batten spacings
up to 900mm centres without wire mesh, it forms a Class 2 vapour barrier that
prevents underside condensation, cuts heavy rain noise by up to 7 dB, and
delivers thermal ratings from R1.3 to R3.0. Made in Australia with a
non-combustible glasswool core (AS 1530.1) and BAL-FZ suitability, it ensures
long-term moisture and thermal protection for Colorbond and metal roofs.
